scenarios.name: Fresh board
scenarios.expected: Sixteen cards, eight pairs, zero moves and zero matched pairs.

scenarios.name: Matching pair
scenarios.setup: Reveal both cards with the same pair ID
scenarios.expected: Both cards remain matched and pair progress increases by one.

scenarios.name: Mismatch
scenarios.setup: Reveal cards with different pair IDs
scenarios.expected: The cards turn back over after a short delay.

scenarios.name: Rapid selection
scenarios.setup: Try to select a third card while a mismatch is resolving
scenarios.expected: The third selection is ignored until the first two cards reset.

scenarios.name: Restart during pending mismatch
scenarios.setup: Reveal a mismatch and immediately restart
scenarios.expected: The previous timeout is cancelled and cannot alter the new round.

scenarios.name: High performance adaptation
scenarios.setup: Evaluate a result with 12 moves and 45 seconds

scenarios.name: History clearing
scenarios.setup: Complete a round and press Clear
scenarios.expected: The local round history is removed.
